title: Help and Advice
intro: Free advice and support with debt, benefits, housing, employment, and consumer issues.

image.alt: Private advice booths at the Toynbee Hall Advice Centre

items.title: Debt and Money
items.description: Free, expert debt advice you can trust. Debt Free Advice is here to help with any money worries.

items.title: Benefits
items.description: We can help you with applications for a range of benefits and help you maximise your income.

items.title: Housing
items.description: If you have a housing issue, our Free Legal Advice Centre may be able to help.

items.title: Employment
items.description: We can help you understand and exercise your employment rights.

items.title: Consumer advice
items.description: We can offer consumer advice on goods and services where things have gone wrong.

blocks.heading: Are you a City of London resident?
paragraphs: We have a dedicated City Advice service for residents or tenants of the City of London.

items.title: Send us an email
items.description: Email advice@toynbeehall.org.uk with your name, address, and a summary of the issue. A team member will get back to you.

items.title: Complete the online form
items.description: Send us a message and a member of our team will get back to you.

sections.text: Our advice is always free and confidential
Here’s what some of our clients say:

blocks.quote: When I received a letter from the County Court about my utility debt, I was really stressed. Debt Free Advice helped to reduce the charge from £2,000 to £800. We also came to an arrangement to pay back the rest of the debt in an affordable monthly chunk. This gave me a massive relief. I want people to know that there’s help out there, however hard you think it is.”

We can’t thank City Advice enough for what they’ve done for me and my husband. Their help with our Personal Independence Payment claims was a lifeline for us. Because of this, our total household’s income has gone up by £12,646.40 per year. We’re forever grateful to them, it has made such a difference to our life”.

I can’t thank you enough for your kindness and assistance. I have so much going on in my head at the moment, as well as managing my loved ones fears, that all this paperwork and wondering how I will manage financially is somewhat scary. I wonder if you know how valued you are to all you help?”

blocks.heading: Contact the advice team
paragraphs: If you’re unsure where to start, use the advice form and the team can point you in the right direction.
